## Natural history notes

A medium-sized mammal characterized by its grayish fur, black facial mask, ringed tail, dexterous front paws, and pointed snout. In Florida, it is found in a wide variety of habitats including forests, hammocks, wetlands, mangroves, agricultural areas, parks, yards, and urban or suburban areas. It is mostly active at night and feeds opportunistically on fruits, nuts, insects, crayfish, eggs, small animals, carrion, and human-associated food sources, often using tree cavities, logs, burrows, or sheltered structures for cover.
